# Silvibe — Premium Adult Toys Wholesale
# Medical-grade silicone adult toys direct from Dongguan factory.
# Low MOQ from 20 pcs. OEM/ODM available. Global shipping.

## About
Silvibe is a B2B wholesale supplier of medical-grade silicone adult toys based in Dongguan, China. We provide direct factory access to retailers, distributors, dropshippers, and e-commerce businesses worldwide.

- Location: Dongguan, Guangdong, China (manufacturing hub)
- Minimum Order: 20 pcs
- Materials: Medical-grade liquid silicone, food-grade solid silicone, TPE/TPR
- Certifications: FDA, CE, RoHS, Phthalate-Free
- Shipping: DHL, UPS, YunExpress — global delivery in 3-7 days
- Response Time: Within 24 hours
- OEM Services: Logo printing, laser engraving, custom packaging, color matching
- ODM Services: Custom product design, material formulation, electronics integration, 3D prototyping
